label: DTU: IB application through optagelse.dk and UnistartDTU

rounds.label: DTU IB application, quota 1 and quota 2
rounds.note: Annual rules, not confirmed 2027 timetable. Every IB applicant applies in March.

milestones.label: DTU: submit IB application and quota 2 personal statement
milestones.note: All IB applicants, both quotas. English motivation letter and CV required for quota 2. Annual rule.

milestones.label: DTU: upload signed PDF to UnistartDTU if you have no Danish CPR number
milestones.note: One signed PDF per DTU application, received by noon or declined. No postal signatures.

milestones.label: DTU: supporting quota 2 documentation
milestones.note: Use 1 April. Quota 2 guidance mentions later evidence for ongoing activities; obtain DTU instructions before relying on later submission. Personal statement is due in March.

milestones.label: DTU: arrange IB online results access (173405)
milestones.note: IB-specific page says no later than 1 June; requirements page says before 1 June. Arrange before 1 June to satisfy both. No time or 2027 year stated.

milestones.label: DTU: last day to reorder priorities
milestones.note: Priorities can change until noon. This is not a final-diploma deadline for same-year IB with DTU online access.

milestones.label: DTU: qualification documents and missing-document instructions
milestones.note: Upload documents already held with your application. Monitor Unistart for individually assigned deadlines; same-year IB uses online release. No separate predicted-grade deadline is published.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Provisional IB candidate results date. Arrange DTU results access beforehand; this is not a separate DTU upload deadline.

milestones.label: DTU: accept or decline in UnistartDTU
DTU: application fee for liable non-EU/EEA applicants
milestones.note: EUR100 before processing; attach receipt. Residence exemptions need evidence. Fee page says 15 March; deadline page says noon.

milestones.label: DTU: autumn tuition for fee-paying students
milestones.note: EUR7,500 upfront; first payment reduced by application fee if applicable. Confirm 2027 invoice and exemption status.

milestones.label: DTU: passed summer supplementary exams or English test
milestones.note: For declared conditional-admission plans accepted by DTU. Upload to Unistart; at most two level raises after 5 July, either quota.

submissionItems.label: Qualification documents or current grade transcript
submissionItems.note: Apply before graduation if needed. For quota 2 DTU recommends current grade transcripts. No separate predicted-grade deadline published. IB needs no statement of hours.

submissionItems.label: English personal statement and CV for quota 2
Signed application PDF where no Danish CPR number
submissionItems.note: Electronic upload; one per DTU application.

submissionItems.label: Authorise DTU IB online results recipient 173405
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: IB results service through your coordinator
submissionItems.note: Same-year IB: arrange before 1 June; no final-diploma upload deadline invented.

submissionItems.label: Passport and residence evidence where applicable
submissionItems.note: Non-EU applicants supply passport/residence evidence. Translate non-English/non-Nordic documents.

submissionItems.label: Application-fee receipt if liable
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: DTU webshop; attach receipt to application
submissionItems.note: Current EUR100 tariff; qualifying residence permits may exempt.

supplementarySteps: Monitor UnistartDTU for receipt, messages and individually assigned document deadlines.
Same-year IB follows online release. EB-only 8 July diploma date and generic final-diploma deadline do not replace this.
For a student residence permit for Denmark, follow DTU permit guidance and offer instructions; no timing waiver beyond published IB online release is implied.

notes: DTU route replaces inherited generic signature, unrelated IB codes and generic reply date.
Annual dates provisional for 2027. No time invented for 1 June or 3 August.
No standby/vacant-place dates rolled from stale 2023/2025 text.
